title: Playable
description: Implemented by audio assets (Sound, AudioStream, AudioGenerator) to support system-driven playback via AudioSystem.play. Assets are **data descriptors** - they hold the audio data and default playback parameters. The playback machinery lives in the Voice returned by `createVoice`; the system is injected at play time, so assets never reach for a global. `createVoice` is a low-level hook meant for asset implementations; consumers should call `audioSystem.play(asset)` instead of invoking it directly.
